verdict.rationale: Snyk has no documented sandbox environment or test org. The closest evidence is that `snyk test` runs locally and reports results in the terminal, and a read-only CLI tester role blocks `snyk monitor`, so a CI service account can test without writing snapshots to the org's live project records. Local MCP server and CLI scanning also run against local files, but none of this is a true isolated sandbox. Missing for 10: a dedicated sandbox or test org/environment, explicit docs on separating test from production data, and hands-on corroboration.
